vat.name: Value Added Tax
vat.statute: Value Added Tax Act Cap. 349 s. 24 (standard rate 18 %), Second Schedule (exempt supplies), Third Schedule (zero-rated supplies), per the Uganda Revenue Authority guide (official secondary)
vat.doc: URA, 'Value Added Tax (VAT)' (Wayback capture 2025-09-04): "Standard rated supplies : These are supplies on which VAT is charged at a rate of 18%. These include all supplies excluding supplies that are included under the second and third schedules of the VAT law"; "Exempt supplies are listed under the second schedule to the VAT law and include; Health insurance and life insurance services Petroleum fuels Social welfare services Educational services Financial Services Passenger transportation services". URA 'A simplified guide to Value Added Tax': "Zero-rated supplies : These are supplies charged VAT at a rate of 0%. Such supplies are listed in the third schedule to the VAT Act. They, among others, include all exports and supply of drugs and medicines". Grade B: the Act itself was not read.
notes: insurance is exempt only for health and life insurance; all insurance taken as exempt
other Second/Third Schedule items (unprocessed food, residential rent, water, etc.) not applied: the schedules were not read
unsupported: Second and Third Schedule items not listed in the URA guide

excise.name: Excise duty
excise.statute: Excise Duty Act 2014 Schedule 2 Part I (ULII consolidation at 31 December 2023) as amended by the Excise Duty (Amendment) Act 2024 s. 3 (in force 1 July 2024); the 2025 amendment (from 1 July 2025) not held
excise.doc: Schedule 2 Part I (consolidation at 31 Dec 2023): "1. Cigarettes ... (b) Hinge lid (i) locally manufactured Ushs. 80,000 per 1000 sticks (ii) imported Ushs. 100,000 per 1000 sticks ... 2. Beer (a) Malt beer 60% or Ushs. 2050 per litre, whichever is higher ... 5. Non-alcoholic beverages (a) Non-alcoholic beverages not including fruit or vegetable juices 12% or Ushs. 250 per litre, whichever is higher". Excise Duty (Amendment) Act 2024 s. 1: "This Act shall come into force on 1st July, 2024"; s. 3 (c): "(c) Any other un-denatured spirits (i) that are locally produced, of alcoholic strength by volume of less than 80%; or (ii) that are imported, of alcoholic strength by volume of less than 80%: 80% or Shs 1700 per litre, whichever is higher"; (d): "(b) Other wines 100% or Shs 10,000 per litre, whichever is higher"; (h): "(a) Motor spirit (gasoline) Shs 1550 per litre (b) Gas oil (automotive, light, amber for high speed engine) Shs 1230 per litre". Percentages are taken on the value before excise and VAT. Grade B: the Excise Duty (Amendment) Act 2025 was not reached.

items.name: Excise duty malt beer
items.statute: Excise Duty Act 2014 Sch. 2 item 2 (a): 60 % or Ushs 2050 per litre

items.name: Excise duty other wines
items.statute: Excise Duty Act 2014 Sch. 2 item 4 (b) (Act 2024 s. 3 (d)): 100 % or Shs 10,000 per litre

items.name: Excise duty un-denatured spirits < 80 %
items.statute: Excise Duty Act 2014 Sch. 2 item 3 (c) (Act 2024 s. 3 (c)): 80 % or Shs 1700 per litre

items.name: Excise duty cigarettes hinge lid (local)
items.statute: Excise Duty Act 2014 Sch. 2 item 1 (b) (i): Ushs 80,000 per 1000 sticks

items.name: Excise duty cigarettes hinge lid (imported)
items.statute: Excise Duty Act 2014 Sch. 2 item 1 (b) (ii): Ushs 100,000 per 1000 sticks

items.name: Excise duty non-alcoholic beverages
items.statute: Excise Duty Act 2014 Sch. 2 item 5 (a): 12 % or Ushs 250 per litre

items.name: Excise duty motor spirit
items.statute: Excise Duty Act 2014 Sch. 2 item 8 (a) (Act 2024 s. 3 (h)): Shs 1550 per litre

items.name: Excise duty gas oil
items.statute: Excise Duty Act 2014 Sch. 2 item 8 (b) (Act 2024 s. 3 (h)): Shs 1230 per litre

notes: local-content beers (30 %), soft-cap cigarettes, opaque beer, local wine (20 %) and bottled water (10 %) not separable from the basket lines
petroleum fuels are VAT-exempt (vatBp 0 in the excise base split)
the Excise Duty (Amendment) Act 2025 (from 1 July 2025) was not reached

cit.name: Income tax (companies)
cit.statute: ITA Cap. 338 Third Schedule Part III para 1 (30 %)
cit.doc: Third Schedule Part III: "1. The income tax rate applicable to companies, other than mining companies, for the purposes of section 7 is 30%." Interest of group members is capped at thirty percent of tax EBITDA (s. 25 (3)-(4), excess carried forward three years): not applied (the company input does not say whether it belongs to a group).
notes: ITA s. 25 (3): interest of group members capped at 30 % of tax EBITDA (group membership not an input): not applied
mining companies' formula rate not applied
unsupported: s. 25 interest cap for group members

wht.name: Non-resident withholding tax
wht.statute: ITA Cap. 338 Third Schedule Part IV para 1 (15 %)
wht.doc: Third Schedule Part IV: "1. The withholding tax rate applicable under section 81, 82, 83 or 84 excluding interest on Government securities is 15%." (s. 82: dividends, interest, royalties, natural resource payments, management charges to non-residents).
